canonicalRequirements.statement: Detect and reject unsupported PASS or status claims.
Detect and reject hardcoded validation success that is not derived from governed inputs.
Detect and reject missing authoritative sources.
Detect and reject source and evidence hash mismatches.
Detect and reject circular validation and self-attestation.
Detect and reject synthetic evidence presented as observed evidence.
Detect and reject invented probabilities or confidence values.
Detect and reject invented timestamps, revisions or identities.
Detect and reject derived outputs that cannot be traced to authoritative inputs.
Detect and reject contradictory evidence without silently choosing one authority.
Detect and reject stale evidence represented as current evidence.
Detect and reject missing required evidence.
Detect and reject evidence mutated after validation or after its identity was bound.

requiredOutputs.role: Validator identity, input, output and provenance registry
Positive, negative, counter and hostile tests
Machine-derived provenance, replay and closure evidence

positiveTests.case: authoritative evidence with matching bytes, hash, identity, revision and provenance
complete derived claim whose inputs and transformations are fully traceable
identical replay in a fresh process with identical canonical bytes
positiveTests.expected: PASS with identical verdict and evidence digest

positiveTests.case: independent validator invocation over an unchanged evidence package

negativeTests.mutation: replace observed evidence with fabricated bytes
claim PASS without the required validation result
hardcode a successful verdict while changing the required input
change evidence bytes without changing the bound hash
make the validator output its own authority input
label a synthetic fixture as observed evidence
insert a probability or confidence value without authoritative support
invent a timestamp, revision or identity not present in authoritative evidence
remove one input edge from a derived output provenance chain
supply contradictory authoritative evidence without a canonical resolution
present evidence older than the applicable as-of boundary as current
modify evidence after its validation identity was bound

countertests.mutation: replace a real computed result with a literal PASS
countertests.expected: the countertest detects the hardcoded success

countertests.mutation: change one authoritative input byte and replay
countertests.expected: the affected claim blocks with a deterministic reason code

countertests.mutation: remove, duplicate or redirect one source edge
countertests.expected: the graph validator blocks and reports the exact defect

countertests.mutation: replace an observed source with a same-shape synthetic fixture
countertests.expected: synthetic evidence is rejected as observed evidence

countertests.mutation: replay the same package in a separate process and working directory
countertests.expected: the result is byte-identical and no ambient state changes the verdict

reuseRules: Reuse only fast-path R4 evidence whose exact source bytes and identities remain unchanged.
Producer PASS, generated projections and summaries never bootstrap authority.
The sealed GATE14 R0005 checkpoint is reusable while its ledger-bound cohort remains byte-identical.
invalidationRules: Any change to the registry, mandate, ledger, dependency checkpoint or validator bytes invalidates the affected identity.
Unknown, stale, contradictory or unverified evidence is non-reusable and blocks closed claims.
R7_FIRST_RUN_BASELINE_SELF_COMPARISON is controlled non-blocking debt for this mission unless current evidence makes it materially relevant.
forbiddenReplays: Broad repository discovery or re-audit of GATE14, GEE R1-R7, the master reuse matrix or historical GATE12/GATE13.
Implementation of GATE15 anti-invention validators in this mission.
Any network call, broker write, Git push, history rewrite, active-gate switch or GEE R8 creation.
Hardcoded PASS, fabricated evidence, future leakage, parallel authority or circular validation.
Mutation of GATE14, GATE16 or any unrelated application path.
packagingRequirements: Stable UTF-8 JSON and exact slash-separated repository-relative paths.
All identities use recomputed SHA-256 over the actual bytes.
Generated views are projections and never canonical authority.
closureConditions: All 14 mandatory anti-invention classes are covered exactly once or with an explicit non-duplicate mapping.
Every declared production validator is exercised and its implementation bytes are verified.
All mandatory positive tests PASS with complete provenance.
All mandatory negative and hostile tests BLOCK with their deterministic reason codes.
Countertests prove that hardcoded, circular and summary-only verdicts do not survive.
Same-input and fresh-process deterministic replay PASS with identical verdicts, reason codes and evidence digests.
Provenance, source identity and exact evidence hashes PASS.
Unexpected writes are zero outside the separately authorized implementation manifest.
No new unrelated regression identity is introduced.
GATE14 remains COMPLETE_CONFIRMED and immutable, GATE16 remains NOT_STARTED, no later gate is authorized and R8 remains ABSENT.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: GATE15 implementation is a separate mission and is limited to the exact authorizedPaths below.
GATE15 closure requires a separate independent confirmation before GATE16 can be authorized.
GATE15 execution does not switch ACTIVE_GATE and does not authorize GATE16 or GEE R8.

sourceReferences.evidence: Canonical GATE15 identity, objective and ordering.
